summary: Steps down a line as an ordered list: done ones checked, the current one ringed and marked for screen readers, the rest hollow.

props.name: currentStep
props.description: The index of the step in progress. Every step before it is done.

props.name: states
props.description: What each state is called under its step, so color is never the only sign of one.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list for screen readers.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.
